title: قانون الرقم القومى للعقارات ترسم الإطار التعريفي للمفاهيم المنظمة لقاعدة البيانات
why: Explains Law 88 of 2025 creating the national database and unified national number for every property (national policy).

title: قانون رقم 88 لسنة 2025 بإنشاء قاعدة بيانات الرقم القومى الموحد للعقارات
why: Law requiring public bodies and utilities to deal with each property through its unified national number (used by services, national).

title: وزير الاتصالات: مشروع الرقم العقاري القومي ينهي تكرار العناوين ويوحّد البيانات
why: Communications minister says the property number will be required for electricity meters and permits, all government bodies bound to it.

title: Enhancing Land Administration for Egypt's New Urban Communities: Pilot in Sheikh Zayed City
why: Project to support the street addressing committee in numbering and coding properties in new cities with CAPMAS (underway).

title: Support to the Modernization of Egyptian Post (Phase III): Annual Report 2025
why: Reports the national postal codes system and GIS database: 5,000 postal assets mapped, 66 postal codes given to postal units.

title: رقم قومى لكل عقار.. إنهاء أزمة المبانى والشوارع المجهولة خلال 3 سنوات
why: States that by end-2022 only 25% of buildings had numbers and about 40% of streets were named.

title: رئيس جهاز الإحصاء: نستهدف الانتهاء من الترقيم والعنونة على مستوى الجمهورية خلال 3 سنوات
why: CAPMAS head says rural Egypt has almost no numbering or streets; nationwide numbering and addressing targeted in 3 years.

title: Building a Modern Egypt Post: Shaping the Future of Public Service Delivery
why: States a nationwide postal code system is implemented for accurate delivery to every district.
